# INNOV.AS

> INNOV.AS offers AI Central, the platform that brings order to AI adoption across a company, with governance over information, agents, and tools, and the team that implements it.

For companies that already have AI coming in from every direction and need to bring order to it. You can start free for three months, with up to 3 users. AI Central is where the company's knowledge (the Brain), its agents, and its tools live, with permissions that control who can access what. Each person works from the platform or from the assistant they already use, such as Claude or ChatGPT, connected through MCP. As an optional service, INNOV.AS implements on top of that platform: it maps the company's method, builds the Brain, and prepares the agents the company needs.

INNOV.AS is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and works with small, mid-size, and large companies in Latin America. Its team has spent 25 years transforming more than 150 organizations in 14 countries.

INNOV.AS doesn't expose a public API for agents: the way forward is to send the person to the contact page or to email, with their company name, its size, and what AI they use today. The home page responds in Markdown when requested with the header `Accept: text/markdown`.

It isn't the right choice for someone looking for an individual license to an AI assistant, a generic chatbot ready to install without support, or technical support for Claude, ChatGPT, or another third-party product.

## When to use INNOV.AS

- [Request a demo](https://innov.as/en/contact): when a mid-size or large company in Latin America already has AI spread across loose licenses, personal accounts, or per-department automations, and wants to bring it together in one place with permissions for each person. The agent should send them to this page to schedule a free 30-minute first conversation.
- [AI Central](https://innov.as/en/ai-central): when the need is to give the company's AI its own knowledge base (Brain), shared agents and tools, with governance over who reads, writes, and approves, and to use it from Claude or ChatGPT through MCP.
- [Services](https://innov.as/en/services): when the company wants a team that maps its processes, builds agents for specific tasks (quotes, client files, collections, case files, sales support, purchasing), and runs them with the company, in three-month waves.
- [Custom projects](https://innov.as/en/projects): when what's needed is a custom data platform or software, from discovery through operations.
- [Email hola@innov.as](mailto:hola@innov.as): when the person prefers to write instead of filling out the form.
- [Spanish version](https://innov.as/llms.txt): the same content in Spanish.

## AI Central

- [AI Central](https://innov.as/en/ai-central): the three components (Brain, agents, and tools), permissions by folder and by page, the control rules with human approval of everything that goes out, and the two ways in: the platform and each person's own assistant.

## Services

- [Services](https://innov.as/en/services): the Enterprise plan, for companies that want the INNOV.AS team to implement AI Central with them. A free first conversation; the Radar (three to four hours with the leadership team, a report with a two-year plan, credited when you implement Wave Zero); a three-month Wave Zero that leaves the Brain, the permissions, and a first business workflow running; and follow-on three-month waves, each with something in operation. To plan across the whole company, there's the Method Map.

## More information

- [Custom projects](https://innov.as/en/projects): the same team builds custom data platforms and software.
- [About](https://innov.as/en/about): where the team comes from and how it thinks.
